findings.location: Paragraph beginning "An example of a bad test, in this respect, is the CEA-125." / corresponding translated paragraph about CA-125
findings.source_quote: An example of a bad test, in this respect, is the CEA-125. CEA-125 is a chemical that is made by some types of cancer. Oncologists use this level to track a patient’s response to chemotherapy.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the author’s original identifier exactly as printed in the English source. Replace “CA-125” in the French translation with “CEA-125” in the two places it appears so the translation faithfully matches the authoritative English text.
findings.translation_quote: Un exemple d’un test médiocre à cet égard est le CA-125. Le CA-125 est une substance chimique produite par certains types de cancer. Les oncologues utilisent ce taux pour suivre la réponse d’un patient à la chimiothérapie.
